## Plugin reference

- Description: Web browser app: each tab is a page in a real Chromium on the machine (persistent profile, so logins stick), streamed to a canvas with input sent back.
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`bookmarks`** — Browser bookmarks UI: a star toggle inside the address pill and a bookmarks bar of clickable chips below the omnibox. Browser bookmarks: the browser_bookmarks table, the browser-bookmarks live…
  - **`engine`** [exempt] — The Browser app's engine, backend half: relays each viewed tab's socket (ENGINE_WS_PATH) byte for byte to the machine's engine host over its Unix socket — launching the host (a detached…
  - **`history`** — Browser history: a headless recorder that logs every navigation to the history store, plus the browserRecents live value (read with useLive). Browser history store (browser_history table), the…
  - **`navigation`** — Browser navigation controls: back / forward / reload (stop while the page loads) buttons in the chrome bar.
  - **`omnibox`** — Browser address bar: URL normalization with search fallback, synced to the current URL.
  - **`shell`** [exempt] — App shell for the Browser app. Registers the /browser app entry, owns the per-surface tab store (each tab a page in the engine's Chromium, addressed by key: navigation requests out, host-reported…
  - **`start-page`** — Browser start page: the empty-state landing shown in the viewport when no URL is loaded — a centered hero (time-of-day greeting + pill search), a grid of pins (curated quick links, then the live…
  - **`tabs`** — Browser tab strip: an in-app row of tabs, each a page in the engine's Chromium showing its title and favicon, with a new-tab button. Renders above the chrome bar.
